lead76_decl_pool_vs_served_cover.classification_evidence: below power: interval not resolved at 4-6 season blocks; mechanism not refuted, no positive control
lead76_decl_pool_vs_served_cover.description: Discrete pooled-prior read at model point vs served opener probability, log loss
lead76_decl_pool_vs_served_cover.plain_summary: The served probabilities are overconfident; a pooled 1999-2019 margin shape at the same model point scores better. This is calibration, not a rule effect.

lead76_decl_rule_vs_pool_cover.classification_evidence: below power: interval not resolved at 4-6 season blocks; mechanism not refuted, no positive control
lead76_decl_rule_vs_pool_cover.description: Rule-era PMF vs pooled PMF at model point, 2020-2025 authentic openers, cover log loss
lead76_decl_rule_vs_pool_cover.plain_summary: Adjusting the margin shape for extra-point and overtime rule eras changed nothing measurable on the real openers.

lead76_decl_rule_vs_pool_margin_logscore.classification_evidence: below power: interval not resolved at 4-6 season blocks; mechanism not refuted, no positive control
lead76_decl_rule_vs_pool_margin_logscore.description: Whole-margin log score, rule-era vs pooled PMF, 2020-2025 openers
lead76_decl_rule_vs_pool_margin_logscore.plain_summary: The rule-era shape scores the exact final margin slightly better, by a tiny amount, in 5 of 6 seasons.

lead76_decl_term_vs_cal_chron.description: Rule term added to recalibrated served probability, chronological folds 2022-2025
lead76_decl_term_vs_cal_chron.plain_summary: As a fitted extra term the rule shape did not help and slightly hurt out of season; its weight was unstable because it is almost the same as the pooled read.

lead76_decl_term_vs_cal_loso.plain_summary: Same result leave-one-season-out: the extra rule term gave no gain.

lead76_rule_term_vs_recalibrated_served.description: Served probability plus fitted rule-minus-pooled term vs served probability recalibrated alone, cover log loss, LOSO 2015-2021
lead76_rule_term_vs_recalibrated_served.notes: 2 of 7 seasons positive; decisive games where the side differs from served: 58-49
lead76_rule_term_vs_recalibrated_served.plain_summary: Adding the rule-era shape reading to the model's cover chance gave a tiny, uncertain gain over just rescaling the model's confidence.

lead76_rule_vs_pooled_prior_cover.description: Rule-era conditioned discrete margin prior vs pooled 1999+ prior, cover log loss, season-block bootstrap, opener proxy 2015-2021
lead76_rule_vs_pooled_prior_cover.notes: Fitted era weight near 0 in every fold; 3 of 7 seasons positive; effect far below detectable size
lead76_rule_vs_pooled_prior_cover.plain_summary: Splitting past games by extra-point and overtime rule era barely changes how likely a team is to cover a spread; the fitted weight on the rule-era games was near zero.

lead76_rule_vs_pooled_whole_margin.description: Whole-margin log score, rule-conditioned vs pooled prior tilted to model point, folds 2013-2021
lead76_rule_vs_pooled_whole_margin.notes: 38 games dropped out of pooled support; 3 of 9 seasons positive
lead76_rule_vs_pooled_whole_margin.plain_summary: Rule-era weighting leaves the odds of each exact final margin essentially unchanged.
